name: harness
description: Manage the AI coding harness itself: check and author CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md/GEMINI.md context docs, audit and refactor harness config, dissect built-in skills, and document installed plugins.

interface.shortDescription: Audit, refactor, and document your AI coding harness
interface.longDescription: Harness bundles the five skills used to keep an AI coding harness healthy: ai-context checks or authors CLAUDE.md / AGENTS.md / GEMINI.md, harness-legacy-check audits the whole harness read-only, harness-refactor applies that audit's low-risk findings, dissect-builtin documents a built-in skill, and plugin-guide documents an installed plugin. This repo also owns the shared per-harness tool-mapping references that the sibling skill repos depend on.
